record.paper_title: Selected Open Problems in Continuous-Time Quantum Walks
record.original_question: For the cycle graph C_9 on nine vertices, determine whether its continuous-time quantum walk admits instantaneous uniform mixing, meaning a time τ at which all entries of the transition matrix U(τ) have the same absolute value (equivalently, all entries of M(τ)=U(τ)∘U(-τ) are equal).

evidence.quote: We say that G admits instantaneous uniform mixing (or simply uniform mixing) at time τ if all entries of M(τ) are equal. Equivalently, G admits uniform mixing at time τ if all entries of U(τ) have the same absolute value.
Determine if C_9 admits uniform mixing.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let C_9 denote the cycle graph on 9 vertices with adjacency matrix A. The continuous-time quantum walk on C_9 is the one-parameter family of unitary matrices U(t) = exp(itA), t ∈ ℝ. For each t, define the doubly stochastic mixing matrix M(t) = U(t) ∘ U(-t) (entrywise Schur product), so that the (j,k)-entry of M(t) equals |U(t)_{j,k}|². The graph is said to admit instantaneous uniform mixing if there exists τ ∈ ℝ such that all entries of M(τ) are equal (equivalently, all entries of U(τ) have the same absolute value 1/3).

Question: Does C_9 admit instantaneous uniform mixing? That is, does there exist τ ∈ ℝ with |U(τ)_{j,k}| = 1/3 for every pair of vertices j, k?
artifact.status_search_result: Known results establish uniform mixing on cycles C_n for n = 3, 4 and rule it out for most other cycles (e.g., C_p for primes p ≥ 5, and C_{2m} for m ≥ 3), but the case of C_9 is not resolved by these results and is repeatedly listed as an open problem in the continuous-time quantum walk literature.

status_evidence.title: Non-uniform mixing of quantum walk on cycles
status_evidence.snippet: Uniform mixing does not occur on C_p for prime p ≥ 5, nor on C_{2m} for m ≥ 3; the status of C_9 is not settled by these results.
status_evidence.claim: C_9 is not covered by the standard non-mixing results for cycles.

status_evidence.title: Uniform Mixing and Association Schemes (Godsil)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys uniform mixing on graphs, listing cycles C_3 and C_4 among the few cycles known to admit uniform mixing.
status_evidence.claim: Only C_3 and C_4 are known among cycles to admit uniform mixing; C_9 remains undetermined.
